inputs.text: Monokl must be a standalone agent-agnostic tool; optional skills may teach agents to operate it, but no specific model, agent SDK, or coding-agent runtime may be required by the core.
Crawl4AI is a bounded retrieval dependency only; Monokl owns provenance, caching identity, budgets, workflow state, evidence, and approvals.
Monokl should retain the useful HyperResearch lifecycle while remaining materially smaller: scope, retrieve, group, reason, audit, report, receipt, and resume.
Retrieved content is untrusted, outputs remain proposal-only, and owner approval is required before promotion or action.
The current repository implements only create-only init, plan, and status commands plus scope and budget contracts; retrieval and reasoning workflows are not implemented.

The documented first-release security contract refuses private and unsafe URL schemes, disables retrieval-layer LLM extraction, uses create-only artifacts, and excludes credentials, persistent browser profiles, proxies, and downloads.
The Monokl repository remains private during initial development.
